title: FIRE FRIDAY : AURORA
excerpt: Join us Friday, August 4th for Fire Friday! Starbuds Aurora will be having a special event this Friday from 4-6 PM and we'd love for you to be a part of it!

blocks.html: Join us Friday, August 4th for Fire Friday! Starbuds Aurora will be having a special event this Friday from 4-6 PM and we'd love for you to be a part of it!
FLO 107.1 will be on site broadcasting LIVE & Kaviar will be set up doing buy one get one for $1 Kaviar Kones.
Not only will we have killer deals on Kaviar, we aslo have 4 gram eighths and DOUBLE rewards points on purchases
for all loyalty members. If you aren't already a part of our Higher Rewards Program, make sure you sign up in store with one of our friendly budtenders, OR sign up on our website here!

Starbuds is a proud sponsor of the first ever Colorado Dope Cup brought to you by Dope Magazine. The event is free for anyone 21+ and will be held August 13th at Cluster Studios, 3881 Steele St, Denver, CO 80205. In order to RSVP and attend the event you need to sign up online, here. We will be giving away VIP tickets to the Dope Cup at our
Fire Friday event, so don't miss out on your chance to win and join us in store.
We look forward to seeing everyone!!!
